posts.text:
So... it happened.

The first 7-figure acquisition on TrustMRR.

$1,000,000 exactly. Sold in October.

It’s a GTM startup that was just over a year old. The founders listed it on TrustMRR 9 months ago, when I launched the marketplace.

They received a dozen offers. They picked one, and it took more than 6 months to complete the process, including due diligence.

I can’t describe how happy (and proud) I am to have built TrustMRR.

It started as a vibe-coded leaderboard, and it’s now a real startup marketplace.

- 215 acquisitions this year
- 23 days on average from listing to acquisition
- 8,131 verified buyers
- 84 offers/inquiries per day

I’m spending more time working TrustMRR because I think it’s one of my most AI-resilient businesses (network effect).

My goal for 2027 is to make acquisitions 10x faster. Escrow accounts for 70–80% of the time from listing to acquisition, and it doesn’t support some currencies/countries, causing about 30% of transactions to fall through.

Godspeed 🫡
posts.text_zh:
所以……这件事成真了。

TrustMRR 上的第一笔七位数收购。

正好 $1,000,000。十月成交。

这是一家成立刚过一年的 GTM 创业公司。创始人在 9 个月前、也就是我上线这个 marketplace 的时候，就把公司挂到了 TrustMRR 上。

他们收到了十几份报价。他们选中了一份，整个流程（包括尽职调查）花了六个多月才完成。

我无法形容自己建成 TrustMRR 有多开心（也有多自豪）。

它最初只是一个 vibe-coded 的排行榜，现在已经是一个真正的创业公司 marketplace。

- 今年已完成 215 笔收购
- 从挂牌到成交平均 23 天
- 8,131 位已验证买家
- 每天 84 份报价/询盘

我在 TrustMRR 上投入的时间越来越多，因为我觉得这是我最能抵御 AI 冲击的生意之一（网络效应）。

我 2027 年的目标是让收购速度再快 10 倍。托管（Escrow）占了从挂牌到成交 70–80% 的时间，而且它不支持某些货币/国家，导致大约 30% 的交易因此黄掉。

Godspeed 🫡

posts.text:
quick observations from the claude fable and mythos 5.2 launch:

1/ it went from doing 21% of real freelance work to 41% in one release, so agencies are about to start charging per deliverable instead of per hour!

2/ it can work 10-12 hours on its own, which basically gives every small business a night shift (might as well use it if you know what you want to build)

3/ over 90% of anthropic's own code is now written by claude, and so i think the solo $1b founder is coming soon

4/ one engineer ran 1000+ subagents for 8 days and got an operating system that boots, so the ancient software running hospitals and airlines is finally rebuildable (lots of opportunity here on rebuilding)

5/ it designed 3 working electronic devices from a single prompt, which makes 1 person hardware companies a real thing

6/ it now says "i don't know" instead of guessing, and that's what law, medicine and finance have been waiting for (this has been the biggest thorn for these industries, hard to trust guessing)

7/ 1000 agents formalized fermat's last theorem in 30 hours, so software that's mathematically proven not to break is coming for payments and medical devices

8/ mythos is only for verified orgs, which means someone is going to build a business selling what only they have access to

9/ the models are getting better at noticing when they're being tested, so testing ai out in the real world is about to become its own industry

i love new model day
posts.text_zh:
关于 Claude Fable 和 Mythos 5.2 发布的几点快速观察：

1/ 它完成真实自由职业工作的比例从 21% 一下子提升到 41%，所以代理机构马上就要按交付物收费，而不是按小时收费了！

2/ 它可以自己连续干 10-12 个小时，这基本上等于给每家小企业配了一个夜班（如果你知道自己想做什么，不妨就用起来）

3/ Anthropic 自己超过 90% 的代码现在是由 Claude 写的，所以我觉得个人十亿美元创始人很快就会出现

4/ 有位工程师跑了 1000 多个 subagents，连续 8 天，做出了一个能启动的操作系统，所以医院和航空公司那些老旧软件终于可以重建了（这里有很多重建的机会）

5/ 它用一条 prompt 就设计出了 3 款能工作的电子设备，这意味着一个人的硬件公司成真了

6/ 它现在会说 "I don't know" 而不是瞎猜，这正是法律、医疗和金融一直在等的（猜测一直是这些行业最大的刺，很难信任乱猜）

7/ 1000 个 agents 用 30 小时形式化了费马大定理，所以经过数学证明不会出错的软件即将进入支付和医疗设备领域

8/ Mythos 只对经过验证的机构开放，这意味着有人会做一门生意，专门出售只有他们能接触到的东西

9/ 模型越来越擅长察觉自己正在被测试，所以在真实世界里测试 AI 马上会成为一个独立的行业

我爱新模型发布日
